Body.Content:
We’re developing an updated FXT Edge Filer appliance. This new hardware will be a Microsoft Azure appliance and facilitate storage optimization in hybrid HPC computing environments. 

This redesigned hardware will take advantage of  Avere software technology to accelerate network-attached storage environments and expand access to Azure Blob. It will enhance current NAS optimization and storage gateway use cases with even larger cache sizes and DRAM. 

Learn more
